classification: lagged market-state drawdown control on frozen 80/20; no promotion

rules.weak_off: core+beta exposure 0.5 when lagged state == weak, else 1.0
rules.weak_or_leanweak_off: exposure 0.5 when lagged state in weak/lean_weak, else 1.0
rules.combined_defensive: exposure 0.5 when lagged weak/lean_weak or breadth < 0.35 or trend < 40, else 1.0

known_limits: Rules use lagged state, but regime history is not a full real-time vintage audit.
Daily exposure changes are an approximation; cash return is zero.
This is a new defense test after observing R405; it is not an independent discovery.
No leverage and no hard 5x rejection.
